summary: Iteration 30 — Migration AI mapping + BizimHesap connector + 69-channel e-commerce catalog + ShopPHP XML integration + Marketplace products (shopphp read-only) + Stock label quick-print. Backend pytest 11/11 PASSED at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration30.py. Frontend Playwright all 13 UI checks PASSED. Details below.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/integrations/ecommerce/add-channel returns id nested inside body.channel.id (not top-level). This is inconsistent with delete which takes id directly in the path — worth documenting for future API clients.

The `groups` array items in GET /api/integrations/ecommerce/catalog use field name `code` (not `id` or `channel`) for the channel identifier while the individual channel row API uses `channel`. Field-name inconsistency across endpoints.

Order dedupe uses both `order_number` and `external_id` — but response uses `order_number` only; older callers relying on `order_no`/`external_order_id` would miss it. Not a bug now, but standardize field names.
seed_data_creation: Test created & removed a Pazarama e-commerce channel (once via API in test, once via UI click; UI-added one was cleaned up via API). Uploaded a temporary xlsx (/tmp/mig_ui.xlsx) and hit /api/migration/parse + /api/migration/ai-map (no import performed). BizimHesap /test called exactly once (returned 200 with real data). ShopPHP sync-now called once (idempotent upsert of the 2 real orders). No production/real data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Add-channel response envelope: {status:'success', channel:{id,channel,channel_name,...}} — id is NESTED under `channel`. Catalog channel field name is `code` (not id). Orders use `order_number` as primary id, external_id for marketplace id. Pazarama channel is safe to add/delete during tests; ShopPHP and Trendyol must never be deleted (have orders). BizimHesap /products call is rate-limited; only call test once per run. ShopPHP marketplace_products push_supported=false and mp-send-btn is hidden. For UI: config-btn-{channel} testid opens settings modal (avoid `button:has-text("Ayarlar")` — matches 8 buttons).
rca of the issue: N/A — all tests pass. Three initial test failures were test-side field-name mismatches (id vs code vs channel; order_no vs order_number); fixed inside test code, no backend changes needed.
